name: The Strange Triangle
description: Apparitions of a strange triangle called Billy, best friends with the Pointed Circle.

name: The Enraged Chair
description: Consumed by the rage of a thousand suns from the inconsiderate bastards who keep sitting on it.

name: The Shapeless
description: Once the ultimate shape, lord of higher dimensions, slipped down on George the Banana and fell into the In-between, forever losing its shape.

name: The Pointed Circle
description: Forged from the trials of infinite pokes from its close friend, Billy, The Strange Triangle.

name: The Silent Banshee
description: After screaming for a millennium in the basement of a beauty salon, a sleep-deprived tailor sewed her mouth shut with golden thread.

name: The Cursed Banana
description: A fateful banana that has been forever cursed by his dastardly cousin, George, to never make anyone trip and fall in a cartoonish manner.

name: The Creative Erasure
description: Created by The Alchemist, who was conducting an experiment on human suffering and the meaning of life.

name: The Depressed Mustache
description:
Name: The Depressed Mustache
Age: 0 days – 78 years
Sex: IDK
Diagnoses: Seasonal Depression.
Reason Stated: Neighbours with The Cloud of Perpetual Sadness.

name: The Basic Acid
description: A failed creation of The Alchemist who was trying to make a solution that could dissolve Anomalies.
